entries.title: Experience Funnel: A State-Policy Alternating Loop for Self-Evolving Agents
entries.summary: Experience Funnel alternates fast textual-state updates with slower policy consolidation, selectively distilling reusable behavior from validated interaction experience into the model so each new state-policy pair can generate better evidence for the next improvement cycle.

entries.title: Procedural Graphs: Self-Evolving Execution Structures for LLM Agents
entries.summary: Procedural Graphs externalize what-to-do knowledge as editable procedure-relation-procedure graphs and let an LLM refiner evolve graph topology and guidance from successful versus failed trajectories, accepting only edits that preserve or improve held-out validation.

entries.title: SE-GoS: Self-Evolving Graph-of-Skills for Skill Library at Scale
entries.summary: SE-GoS improves a large agent skill graph directly from execution traces by evolving topology, edge weights, and retrieval-facing descriptions, yielding higher task reward and lower input-token use without retraining the underlying model.

entries.title: Reason Through the Latent! Making Latent Visual Reasoning Necessary
entries.summary: Causal Visual Recurrent Reasoning makes a recurrent hidden state the required image-conditioned path to a vision-language model's answer, repeatedly refining that state while rereading fixed visual evidence so latent computation is causally necessary rather than merely present.

entries.title: Looped GPT-BERT: Trading Parameters for Computation in Small Language Modeling
entries.summary: Looped GPT-BERT applies depth-wise parameter sharing so four physical layers execute twelve recurrent traversals, showing that extra recurrent computation can recover competitive BabyLM linguistic performance with a substantially smaller parameter set.

entries.title: Thinking with Looped Flows
entries.summary: Looped Flows trains recurrent computation with local denoising objectives linked across time by shared, progressively reduced noise, then spends more inference compute by integrating a learned probability flow; it improves over prior looped models across six reasoning benchmarks.

entries.title: Continual Learning Mechanisms Compose for Long-Horizon Memorization
entries.summary: Across 100 sequential language-model update tasks, the paper finds that composing data, function, and weight anchors with low-rank allocation is far stronger than any single continual-learning mechanism, raising average final retention from 1.2% to 34.9%.

entries.title: When Synthetic Data Hurts: On Catastrophic Forgetting in Skill Retrieval for LLM Agents
entries.summary: A 34,396-skill Qwen retrieval study shows synthetic-data fine-tuning can erase real and out-of-distribution skill competence, while continual-learning regularizers such as embedding anchoring, LwF, EWC, and L2-to-initialization preserve prior retrieval and still improve the synthetic domain.

entries.title: Grounding Agent Memory: Environment-Probing Curation for Enterprise Agents
entries.summary: Environment-probing curation gives a persistent-memory LLM agent's asynchronous curator read-only world tools to verify, scope, and refresh memories across sessions, improving CLBench pass rate from 39% to 73% without retraining the task model or changing its retriever.

entries.title: NeoHorse-1: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement via Agentic Post-Training with Routing Harness
entries.summary: NeoHorse-1 turns routing and evaluation traces into a three-stage post-training curriculum plus routing-guided on-policy distillation, then feeds capability evaluation back into the next training mixture to close an evaluation-selection-update self-improvement loop.

entries.title: LeCor: Learning to Be Corrected by Meta-Learned Test-Time Training for Interactive 3D Lung-Tumour Segmentation
entries.summary: LeCor converts user corrections into test-time gradient updates on small per-case adapters that are meta-learned to improve unclicked slices, turning a promptable SAM 3 system from memory-only correction into an architecture that learns during deployment.

entries.title: Data-Efficient Language Modeling: From Frontier Advancement to Principle-Guided Model Improvement
entries.summary: A BabyLM research program links autonomous experimentation, principle discovery, and principle-guided continuation training so findings from one generation change the next model-design cycle, providing an empirical example of research-process recursive self-improvement.
